reason: 该插件主要用于增强 dsh-better-sidebar 的导航体验：在内置资源管理器中内置文件筛选与按类型徽章显示，并提供文件定位能力。证据主要来自 README 与包配置，显示其为界面级改造插件，核心行为为浏览器端 DOM/CSS 注入和文件树/编辑器视觉增强，故风险集中在兼容性与界面稳定性而非系统权限修改。

summaries.zh: 该插件为 dsh-better-sidebar 的内置资源管理器提供内嵌文件筛选搜索，并在资源树与编辑器标签页按文件类型显示徽章。
summaries.en: This plugin adds an inline file search/filter inside the built-in dsh-better-sidebar Explorer and shows file-type badges in the explorer tree and editor tabs.

capabilities: Adds an inline filter/search box to the built-in Explorer tab of the better-sidebar interface.
Provides per-file-type visual badges for explorer tree entries and editor tabs.
Supports file reveal/navigation actions and uses file index/tree lookup routes.
Applies DOM/CSS/UI injection and MutationObserver-based updates in the web client.

reasons.code: README states a filter box is injected into the built-in Explorer header and DOM observers are used for updates.
README describes backend-style routes (/index, /tree, /reveal) used for file indexing, listing, and reveal behavior.
package.json defines web client platform with dsh client runtime injection, indicating client-side UI modification scope.
